name: Urban Contemporary Gospel
prompt: Contemporary urban gospel with pocketed drums, deep bass, piano or modern keys, expressive lead singing, choir responses, and a polished uplifting chorus.

name: Gospel Soul
prompt: Gospel-soul with Hammond organ, warm bass, live drums, blues-rooted guitar, powerful lead voice, and responsive backing choir.

name: Praise and Worship
prompt: Modern praise-and-worship music with piano or acoustic guitar, steady live drums, supportive bass, spacious pads, congregational vocal phrasing, and a gradual uplifting build.

name: Traditional Gospel Quartet
prompt: Traditional gospel quartet feel with piano or organ, live bass and drums, close male or mixed harmony, call-and-response phrasing, and energetic church-room dynamics.

name: Texas Blues
prompt: Texas electric blues with biting guitar, solid bass, swinging live drums, organ or piano color, and confident vocal-and-guitar call-and-response.

name: Swamp Blues
prompt: Swamp blues with lazy syncopated groove, tremolo or gritty guitar, deep bass, restrained drums, humid room atmosphere, and understated vocal phrasing.

name: Acoustic Country Blues
prompt: Acoustic country blues with fingerpicked or slide guitar, sparse foot-stomp or brushed rhythm, intimate voice, and raw story-first performance.

name: Modern Blues Soul
prompt: Modern blues-soul with expressive electric guitar, warm bass, pocketed drums, organ, strong lead vocals, and polished but human dynamics.

name: Cumbia Pop
prompt: Cumbia-pop with buoyant percussion, syncopated bass, bright guitar or keys, melodic lead vocals, and a concise crossover chorus.

name: Latin Rock
prompt: Latin rock with electric guitars, bass and live drums combined with Latin percussion, melodic Spanish-language vocal phrasing, and an anthemic chorus.

name: Merengue Pop
prompt: Merengue-pop with fast bright percussion, active bass, piano or synth stabs, energetic vocals, and a compact dance-floor hook.

name: Latin R&B
prompt: Latin R&B with deep modern bass, pocketed drums, warm keys or guitar, intimate melodic vocals, and restrained urban-pop production.

name: Slam Poetry
prompt: Rhythmic spoken poetry with no sung melody: dynamic breath, deliberate pauses, internal verbal rhythm, clear diction, and optional minimal underscore kept beneath the voice.

name: Audiobook Storytelling
prompt: Natural long-form spoken storytelling with clear character distinction, measured pacing, intimate narration, and no musical phrasing in the voice.

name: Radio Drama
prompt: Dramatic spoken performance with distinct character voices, dialogue timing, controlled sound-design space, and speech intelligibility kept above any underscore.

name: Documentary Voiceover
prompt: Authoritative documentary voiceover with neutral clarity, natural emphasis, measured pacing, and restrained cinematic underscore that never competes with speech.

name: New Age Ambient
prompt: New-age ambient with warm pads, gentle piano or acoustic color, slow harmonic movement, soft nature-like texture, and restorative open space.

name: Meditation Music
prompt: Meditative ambient music with slow breathing room, soft sustained timbres, minimal harmonic tension, subtle bells or bowls, and no abrupt dynamic changes.

name: Healing Soundscape
prompt: Calm healing soundscape with long warm tones, gentle harmonic overtones, sparse soft percussion or chimes, and an unhurried restorative arc.

name: Nature Ambient
prompt: Nature-inflected ambient with soft pads, subtle acoustic textures, gentle water-or-wind-like ambience, minimal rhythm, and wide peaceful space.

name: Celtic Folk Fusion
prompt: Celtic-rooted fusion with fiddle, whistle or pipes, acoustic strings, hand percussion or live drums, and modern bass while preserving traditional melodic contour.

name: Middle Eastern Pop Fusion
prompt: Middle-Eastern pop fusion with modal melody, oud or plucked-string color, hand percussion, modern bass and drums, and a clear melodic crossover hook.

name: Indian Pop Fusion
prompt: Indian pop fusion with tabla or hand percussion, raga-informed melodic color, contemporary bass and drums, layered vocals, and a polished crossover chorus.

name: Global Acoustic Fusion
prompt: Acoustic world-fusion ensemble built from clearly identified regional strings, winds or percussion, natural bass, and coherent modern song form without flattening the source timbres.

name: Musical Comedy
prompt: Musical comedy with character-led vocals, clear setup-and-payoff timing, coherent accompaniment, and a recurring melodic joke or phrase that supports the scene.

name: Comedy Rock
prompt: Comedy rock with real electric-guitar, bass and live-drum arrangement, strong chorus writing, and punchlines placed cleanly inside a believable rock song.

name: Comedy Country
prompt: Comedy country with acoustic and electric roots instrumentation, natural drums, plainspoken storytelling, and a clear comic narrative that lands inside a proper country arrangement.

name: Comedy R&B
prompt: Comedy R&B with smooth pocketed production, melodic vocals, harmony stacks, and intentionally serious musical execution supporting an absurd or witty lyrical premise.

name: Gregorian Drill Opera
prompt: A deliberately strange sacred-chant, opera and drill hybrid retained as an experimental legacy choice rather than being presented as a normal Hip-Hop or Classical style.

name: Genre Roulette Mutation
prompt: A deliberate multi-genre mutation retained as an experimental legacy choice rather than appearing inside a mainstream parent genre.

name: Opera Rock
prompt: Theatrical rock that combines electric-guitar, bass and live-drum weight with operatic scale, dramatic vocal projection, and large arrangement changes.

name: Gothic Post-Punk
prompt: Gothic post-punk with chorus-soaked guitar, melodic bass, spacious drums, minor-key atmosphere, and romantic nocturnal melancholy.
